LinkedIn has officially become a ChatGPT roleplay server.

Every post sounds the same.
Every sentence is “intentional leadership,” “aligned teams,” and “powerful reminders.”
And somehow… it all leads back to a printed certificate, a pizza party, or a guy sitting on a tractor.

In this video, we go through some of the most unhinged, buzzword-filled LinkedIn posts I could find and try to figure out what they’re actually saying… or if they’re saying anything at all.

Because at some point, you have to ask:
Are people even reading this…
title: EVERYONE ON LINKEDIN IS CHATGPT! - ITS NOT THIS, ITS THAT!
